# External datasets

## flights.csv
- Source: seaborn-data repository (`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mwaskom/seaborn-data/master/flights.csv`)
- Content: monthly totals of international airline passengers, 1949–1960 (144 rows)
- License: BSD-3-Clause (seaborn-data repository license)
- Use: real-data validation of the drift-monitoring method (scripts/external_validation.py)
